'''Trooper1124 Dagobah Attack''' is a [[Light]] deck by Trooper1124, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls89.htm Dagobah Attack], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319194129/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls89.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
